budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town's total grant request to MassDOT's Tier 3 Complete Streets program is for three Main Street area portions.
The Town was announced as a recipient of a PARC grant and a LAND grant for the Northfield Road property.
budget_items.quote: a recipient of a $100,000 parc grant and a $400,000 land grant

budget_items.topic: Northfield Road land purchase price after grants
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The total purchase price for 318 acres at 961 and 964 Northfield Road is $782,000, which becomes $282,000 after grant reimbursement of $500,000; the purchase is a Special Town Meeting article.
budget_items.quote: the total purchase price is $782,000 and after reimbursement from the grants is received in the amount of $500,000, the price is $282,000.

budget_items.topic: North Cemetery Niche Wall ramp project grant request
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $17,000 Project Grant was requested by the Cemetery Commission to build an ADA ramp and railings to the Niche Wall.
budget_items.quote: the other grant application was for a project grant request in the amount of $17,000 to install a ramp

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Last year's grant round was very competitive, with only 30 of 100 applications chosen and an average request near $30,000.
budget_items.quote: only 30 were chosen with the average request being around $30,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An updated cost estimate from an environmental consultant and possible funding sources are the next steps; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: i will get an updated cost estimate from an environmental consultant
